extension.description: Translate VS Code hover documentation through configurable translation services.
command.trigger.title: Floating Translation: Translate Hover
command.configureCredentials.title: Floating Translation: Configure Credentials
command.clearCredentials.title: Floating Translation: Clear Credentials
configuration.title: Floating Translation
configuration.sourceLanguage.description: The source language code of the text to translate.
configuration.targetLanguage.description: The target language code for translations. When empty, the current VS Code display language is used.
configuration.translationTool.descriptio: The translation service currently in use.
configuration.translationMode.fullText.d: Send the complete Hover Markdown to the translation service without protecting code or formatting.
configuration.translationMode.codeBlocks: Keep fenced and indented code blocks local, and send the remaining original Markdown to the translation service.
configuration.translationMode.remotePlac: Send placeholders with the text to preserve sentence context. Some services may modify the placeholders.
configuration.translationMode.localPlace: Keep placeholders local and send only the natural language between them. This provides the strongest protection but reduces context and may lower translation accuracy.
configuration.translationMode.descriptio: Controls which content is sent to the translation service and how protected content is handled.
configuration.maxCacheCount.description: The maximum number of translation cache entries stored for the current workspace.
configuration.credentialStorage.descript: How credentials for translation services are read and written. After selecting encrypted storage, select a translation service and run `Floating Translation: Configure Credentials` to store its credentials.
configuration.generalPlatformCredentials: The maximum number of requests started per second and in progress at the same time.

Request limits and credentials for general translation services. QPS always applies. Credentials are read only when the storage method is plain-text settings; credential fields are ignored when `floating-translation.credentialStorage` is `secretStorage`.
configuration.openAiCompatibleConfigurat: Configuration for an OpenAI-compatible service. The endpoint must be a complete Chat Completions URL; the extension does not append a path automatically. The model identifier must match the target service's model list. A custom prompt cannot override the extension's output and structure-protection constraints. The API key is read only when credentials use plain-text settings.
